id.description: Parsed id of the matched document or account; for comments, the document containing the comment.

commentId.description: Id of the matched comment, without the `hm://` prefix; set only when `type` is `comment`.

metadata.description: Metadata of the matched resource, when included.

title.description: Matched content: a title, or the matching excerpt with surrounding context.

icon.description: Icon of the document containing the match.

parentNames.description: Names of the parent documents, for breadcrumb display.

versionTime.description: Time of the matched version, formatted as a locale date-time string.

searchQuery.description: The query this result was returned for.

type.description: Kind of entity that matched: `document`, `contact`, or `comment`.

description: One hit of a network search: the matched id with its title, icon, parent names, and the kind of entity matched.
